description.title: Description
description.description: What the module provisions and when to use it.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Module input variables. Each item: {name, type, default, description}.

repo_path.title: Repo Path
repo_path.description: Path of the module in the public workshop repo, e.g. modules/aws/rds-postgres.

allowed_in_production.title: Allowed in Production
allowed_in_production.description: Whether this module may be used in the production environment.

requires_second_approver.title: Requires Second Approver (deprecated)
requires_second_approver.description: Deprecated - not used by the workflow. Use 'Needs approval' (requires_approval) instead.

cost_tier.title: Cost Tier
cost_tier.description: Rough cost tier of resources created by this module.

requires_approval.title: Needs approval
requires_approval.description: If true, every request using this module needs a human approval from the owning team, regardless of environment.

inputs_summary.title: Inputs Summary
inputs_summary.description: Readable list of the module inputs (generated from the Inputs array).
inputs_summary.calculation: (.properties.inputs // []) | map("- `" + .name + "` (" + (.type // "any") + (if has("default") then ", default `" + (.default | tostring) + "`" else ", required" end) + "): " + (.description // "")) | join("\n")

requests_30d.title: Requests (30d)
requests_30d.description: Infra requests that used this module in the last 30 days.

owning_team.title: Owning Team
owning_team.description: Platform team that owns and maintains the module.
